_comment: Bo du lieu demo gon nhe cho API POST http://localhost:9001/v1/test/profile-ingestion/send. Gui TUAN TU dung thu tu id 1->7 (cac case sau phu thuoc profile da tao o case truoc). Muc tieu: minh hoa du cac nhanh quyet dinh chinh (CREATE_NEW_PROFILE, AUTO_MERGE, CREATE_MATCH_CANDIDATE, NEED_REVIEW, REJECT) de co du lieu demo tren nhieu bang: master_profiles, profile_source_records, profile_identity_links, profile_match_candidates, profile_match_reasons.

samples.description: CRM tao profile moi - Nguyen Van An (baseline, dung lam target AUTO_MERGE o case 4)
PORTAL tao profile moi - Tran Thi Binh (baseline, dung lam target CREATE_MATCH_CANDIDATE o case 5)
CAS tao profile moi - Le Van Cuong (baseline, dung lam target NEED_REVIEW o case 6)
CMS gui trung identityNo voi profile #1 (Nguyen Van An), phone/email da doi
samples.expectedDecision: AUTO_MERGE (fast-path: identityNo trung -> merge truc tiep, khong qua cham diem)

samples.description: POSTID gui trung phone + fullName voi profile #2 (Tran Thi Binh) nhung KHONG co identityNo -> roi vao nhanh cham diem: phone(40)+fullName exact(30)=70
samples.expectedDecision: CREATE_MATCH_CANDIDATE (score=70, matchLevel=MEDIUM) - tao ban ghi cho admin review, KHONG tu dong merge

samples.description: MYVNPOST gui trung phone voi profile #3 (Le Van Cuong) nhung identityNo khac hoan toan
samples.expectedDecision: NEED_REVIEW (fast-path: identityNo mau thuan -> can admin xu ly conflict)

samples.description: sourceSystem khong hop le (WEBSITE khong nam trong enum CRM/CMS/PORTAL/MYVNPOST/POSTID/CAS)
